outcome: Congenital malformation (neonate, including spina bifida, cleft lip and palate, heart disease)
cohort: 400 pregnant women attending the Outpatient and Inpatient departments of Government Maternity Hospital, Tirupati.
finding: Numerous maternal and neonatal complications were observed among overweight and obese pregnant women compared to those with normal BMI.
mod_finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy overweight and obesity were associated with an increased risk of assisted vaginal delivery, instrumental delivery, and elective caesarean delivery.
